goal: Build a verified GBA/GBC opportunity database before Platinum implementation.

donors.policy: mine deltas only unless shared resource evidence is needed
delta against Emerald; avoid duplicate work

replacement_policy: Rare. Promote only when whole-asset reuse is clearly preferable to Platinum-native reconstruction or component/technique transfer.
no_go: Do not modify Platinum gameplay/source/assets during database collection.
Do not activate deferred findings without donor verification.
Do not rewrite the DS opportunity pool.
Do not build general-purpose renderers when a targeted decoder is enough.
Do not manually inspect thousands of assets when code/source relationships can narrow the set.
stop_conditions: Every available donor has a source map.
Every major high-value subsystem has been considered.
Prior seed findings are verified, rejected, or explicitly left needs-evidence.
Ruby duplication against Emerald is resolved.
A separate GBA/GBC opportunity pool exists.
A combined DS + GBA/GBC ranking can be generated without flattening provenance.
